items.title: Press Briefing by the Spokesperson on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Rescuers have recovered 903 bodies so far, with around 4200 people still unaccounted for. More than 10,000 people have been brought to safety, including over 323 foreign nationals, while about 590 foreigners from 39 countries remain missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing by the Spokesperson on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Nepal Police — DNA profiling for unidentified remains
items.summary: Families with relatives missing after the Rasuwa and Bhote Koshi floods can help identify remains by giving DNA samples. Close family members in Nepal can drop off a fresh blood sample and two photos at the Nepal Police Hospital in Maharajgunj or the nearest district police office.
items.citation: Nepal Police HQ — Information on DNA Profiling for unidentified Dead Bodies (31 Aug)

items.source: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
items.title: NDRRMA — Bhotekoshi water level rising again (31 Aug)
items.summary: Water levels in the Bhotekoshi River have risen again. People in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Chitwan and nearby areas should stay cautious.
items.citation: NDRRMA Nepal — public warning via official channels

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Sunday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)
items.summary: After the floods hit on August 26, crews have recovered 734 bodies and rescued more than 8,000 people. About 2,500 remain missing, including over 400 foreigners.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Sunday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, and teams have recovered 626 bodies while about 2400 people are still missing. Over 4450 people have been rescued so far, including more than 187 foreign nationals, with teams from India and China helping in the search.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure while leaving many people missing. Rescue teams have recovered 538 bodies so far, and 511 of the 632 people from 33 countries remain unaccounted for.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue teams and helicopters are working at the mudslide site in Gyirong Port, where three people were killed and 558 remain missing as of Thursday morning. More rescuers have arrived with supplies while crews try to clear a blockage upstream.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August, killing many and leaving hundreds missing. So far 359 bodies have been recovered and 596 people from 33 countries remain unaccounted for.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: Nepal's foreign ministry has set up an emergency room to help with foreign nationals missing or affected in the Rasuwa floods. Call or message +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 from 7am to 10pm.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood

items.title: Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation
items.summary: India's foreign ministry has opened a 24-hour control room in Delhi for the Nepal floods. Families can call 011-23088718 or message +91 9968291988 on WhatsApp.
items.citation: MEA press release — Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods struck Nepal this morning, damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. Rescue teams have recovered 72 bodies so far, with 403 people reported missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026

items.title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
items.summary: The Indian embassy in Kathmandu is working with local authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals hit by the floods in Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi. Families can reach the Delhi control room or the embassy WhatsApp for help.
items.citation: Embassy of India, Kathmandu
